days.title: Highlight report HR-06 · 19–23 October 2026
days.caption:
Project update · HR-06 · 19–23 October 2026

Status: AMBER. Work on plan at £0 spend.
11 replies from public bodies past their due date; 9 late or with questions left open.

This period:
• Deadline ledger: 57 requests to 21 bodies set against FOIA s.10, EIR reg 5(2) and 11(4), UK GDPR Art 12(3), the s.45 Code of Practice, or the body's own published standard
• Dartboard: 20 markers placed at each missed due date, tap-to-expand detail
• Email archive: 39 case emails ingested into the archive and email calendar

Due in the next 7 days:
• Mon 26 Oct · Vale of Glamorgan Council · EIR: removal of a commemorative tree
• Mon 26 Oct · Vale of Glamorgan Council · EIR: s.52/land charges and planning records, Great House Farm / Church View Close
• Mon 26 Oct · South Wales Police · Internal review of 719/26
• Mon 26 Oct · Wales Office / NIO · Farm ownership records: internal review
• Wed 28 Oct · Vale of Glamorgan Council · Formal concern, preservation and subject access
• Wed 28 Oct · HM Land Registry · Subject access request: titles WA231076 and WA240304
…and 2 more in the full report

Top grounds to reopen the case:
1. The farmhouse's separate 1983 registration while the 1974 action stood unheard
2. Whether the 1974 letters were rejected in writing
3. Whether a binding sale existed when the October 1974 letters were written

Full report: https://projects.bucklerfamily.estate/hr-06-2026-10-22/
